component.name: Deskflow
component.summary: Native GTK4 + Libadwaita control center for Deskflow & ESP32 Station

description.p: DeskFlow Station is a native GNOME/GTK4 + Libadwaita desktop application for managing Focus Mode, Sticky Notes, Exam Countdowns, 24-Hour Weather Forecasts, Morse Code hardware playback, and ESP32 OLED display controls.
